name: 4S The Aurrum
summary: The project exists. Its developer (4S Developers), its location (Sector 59, Golf Course Extension Road), its RERA number (GGM/849/581/2024/76) and its under-construction status are confirmed, and the ₹5 Cr starting price is within range. Our configuration list mislabels units: sources give 3 BHK at 2,407-2,624 sq ft and 4 BHK at 3,257-3,562 sq ft, but we list a 4 BHK at 2,407/2,624 and a 3 BHK at 3,562, and we omit the 3,257 size. Land area and unit count disagree sharply between sources (5.43 ac/243 units vs 10.07-11 ac/550 units), and no source we could read gave a RERA possession date.
